name: vifito-desktop
description: Desktop app that reads live data from a VIFITO Rio 45 iR treadmill over Bluetooth FTMS

scripts.check: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run third-party:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.package: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
